title: Claude Opus 4.5 joins the text models
summary:
Claude Opus 4.5 and Nano Banana Pro joined the model lineup, chat validation got less picky, and three community projects joined the listings.

Added Claude Opus 4.5 as `claude-large`, with image input and tool support. `claude` now selects Sonnet 4.5, while Haiku moves to `claude-fast`. Bedrock models also default to 16,384 max tokens unless a request specifies otherwise.

Added `nanobanana-pro`, backed by Gemini 3 Pro Image, to the image model registry. It uses the existing Nano Banana image-generation path, including width and height parameters, and is described as supporting 4K images and Thinking.

Chat completion validation now accepts provider-specific finish reasons in regular and streaming responses, plus assistant messages with missing content. That keeps valid Gemini responses from being rejected for not looking quite enough like OpenAI.

highlights.title: Claude Opus 4.5 added
highlights.text: Use `claude-large` for Claude Opus 4.5 with image input and tool support. `claude` now selects Sonnet 4.5; Haiku is available as `claude-fast`. [Browse Claude Opus 4.5](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=claude-large).

highlights.title: Nano Banana Pro added
highlights.text: Generate images with `nanobanana-pro`, backed by Gemini 3 Pro Image and described as supporting 4K output and Thinking. [Browse Nano Banana Pro](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=nanobanana-pro).
